key: "Citrine Cave"
en: "Citrine Cave"
ja: 「シトリンどうくつ」

key: QUASH!
en: QUASH!
ja: さきおくり!

key: I'm giga-brained.
en: I'm giga-brained.
ja: ボクは　ギガ脳なのさ

key: I'm goated with the sauce.
en: I'm goated with the sauce.
ja: ボクは　サイコーに　イケてるのさ

key: Trainer! Are you ready to take the Rainbow Challenge (tm)?!
en: Trainer! Are you ready to take the Rainbow Challenge (tm)?!
ja: トレーナー! レインボーチャレンジ(tm)に　挑む　覚悟は　いいかい!?

key: Face off against our multicolor dream-team in the ring and win yourself, uh, something!!!
en: Face off against our multicolor dream-team in the ring and win yourself, uh, something!!!
ja: リングで　色とりどりの　ドリームチームと　戦って　えーと　何かを　勝ち取るんだ!!!

key: Will you, fair Trainer, take this definitely legitimate challenge?!
en: Will you, fair Trainer, take this definitely legitimate challenge?!
ja: さあ　トレーナー君。この　まちがいなく　正真正銘の　挑戦を　受けるかい!?

key: Marvelous!
en: Marvelous!
ja: すばらしい!

key: And now, we spin the Wheel of Color to determine your fate!
en: And now, we spin the Wheel of Color to determine your fate!
ja: それでは　運命を　決める　カラーホイールを　回そう!

key: And the color it lands on is...
en: And the color it lands on is...
ja: 出た色は……

key: ...All of them!
en: ...All of them!
ja: ……全部だ!

key: What do you mean we have Rainbow Challenge at home!?
en: What do you mean we have Rainbow Challenge at home!?
ja: レインボーチャレンジなら　うちにもある　って　どういうことだい!?

key: Hah, so that's it!
en: Hah, so that's it!
ja: ハッ　そういうことか!

key: Powerful you are indeed to triumph over the class act calamity-level power of this Definitely The Real Rainbow Challenge!
en: Powerful you are indeed to triumph over the class act calamity-level power of this Definitely The Real Rainbow Challenge!
ja: この　まちがいなく本物の　レインボーチャレンジの　災害級の　実力を　破るとは　まさに　強者だ!

key: I am so impressed, I simply have to give you a prize right now this very instant!
en: I am so impressed, I simply have to give you a prize right now this very instant!
ja: 感服したよ。今この場で　賞品を　贈らずには　いられない!

key: Hmm, let's see, what can I give a valiant fighter like yourself...
en: Hmm, let's see, what can I give a valiant fighter like yourself...
ja: ふむ　君のような　勇敢な戦士に　何を　贈ろうか……

key: Ah, I know!
en: Ah, I know!
ja: ああ　そうだ!

key: Surely for as many battles as you get in, this will be a helpful and worthwhile item for you!
en: Surely for as many battles as you get in, this will be a helpful and worthwhile item for you!
ja: これだけ　戦っている君なら　きっと　役に立つ　値打ちものだ!

key: You need not thank me all at once, it is quite all right-- I know I am as generous as I am humble.
en: You need not thank me all at once, it is quite all right-- I know I am as generous as I am humble.
ja: 礼は　いっぺんに　しなくていい——私は　謙虚さと同じくらい　気前がいいと　自覚しているのでね

key: Until next time, brave warrior!
en: Until next time, brave warrior!
ja: また会う日まで　勇敢なる戦士よ!

key: Too bad, so sad, boo hoo, and alladat hullaballo!
en: Too bad, so sad, boo hoo, and alladat hullaballo!
ja: 残念　無念　しくしく　てんやわんや!

key: Maybe next time you'll have what it takes for the totally legitimate Rainbow Challenge!!!
en: Maybe next time you'll have what it takes for the totally legitimate Rainbow Challenge!!!
ja: 完全に　正真正銘の　レインボーチャレンジには　次こそ　通用するかもね!!!

key: We await the brave here in this very spot!
en: We await the brave here in this very spot!
ja: 勇者を　まさに　この場所で　待っているよ!

key: And NOT in the circus!
en: And NOT in the circus!
ja: サーカスでは　ないからね!

key: What are you looking at me like that for?
en: What are you looking at me like that for?
ja: なんで　そんな目で　見るんだい?

key: Don't tell me you're not satisfied with your prize!?
en: Don't tell me you're not satisfied with your prize!?
ja: まさか　賞品に　満足していないとでも!?
ああ……「はい」……

key: So, yes, you ARE satisfied with your prize, right?
en: So, yes, you ARE satisfied with your prize, right?
ja: つまり　賞品に　満足している　ということだね?

key: Great, glad to hear it!
en: Great, glad to hear it!
ja: けっこう。何よりだよ!

key: We're always happy, here at Definitely The Rainbow Challenge Incorporated, to offer you only the best prizes!
en: We're always happy, here at Definitely The Rainbow Challenge Incorporated, to offer you only the best prizes!
ja: 我ら　まちがいなくレインボーチャレンジ株式会社は　いつでも　最高の賞品だけを　お届けするよ!
ああ……「いいえ」……

key: So... you are NOT telling me that you're not satisfied with your prize, right?
en: So... you are NOT telling me that you're not satisfied with your prize, right?
ja: つまり……賞品に　満足していないとは　言っていない　ということだね?

key: Wonderful, another happy customer!
en: Wonderful, another happy customer!
ja: すばらしい。また　ひとり　満足のお客様だ!

key: We're proud to have served you faithfully, and we hope you'll always keep our superior version of the Rainbow Challenge in your heart!!!
en: We're proud to have served you faithfully, and we hope you'll always keep our superior version of the Rainbow Challenge in your heart!!!
ja: 誠心誠意　お仕えできて　光栄だ。我らの　上位版レインボーチャレンジを　いつまでも　心に　留めておいてくれ!!!

key: Ugh, okay-- okay, I get the picture.
en: Ugh, okay-- okay, I get the picture.
ja: うっ　わかった——わかったよ　察したさ

key: You want something else.
en: You want something else.
ja: ほかの物が　ほしいんだろう

key: You probably saw this white item ball behind me and assumed I had a Mega Stone to give you, right?
en: You probably saw this white item ball behind me and assumed I had a Mega Stone to give you, right?
ja: 後ろの　白いアイテムボールを　見て　メガストーンが　もらえると　思ったんだろう?

key: But unfortunately, this isn't a Mega Stone.
en: But unfortunately, this isn't a Mega Stone.
ja: だが　残念ながら　これは　メガストーンじゃない

key: It's just a floor mat that's suspiciously SHAPED and COLORED like a Mega Stone.
en: It's just a floor mat that's suspiciously SHAPED and COLORED like a Mega Stone.
ja: ただの　床マットさ。やたら　メガストーンっぽい　形と　色をしているだけの

key: Convincing, isn't it!?
en: Convincing, isn't it!?
ja: そっくりだろう!?

key: I was hoping it would rope in the customers...
en: I was hoping it would rope in the customers...
ja: 客を　引き寄せられればと　思ってね……

key: Given that I'm not allowed on circus grounds...
en: Given that I'm not allowed on circus grounds...
ja: サーカスの　敷地には　入れてもらえないものでね……

key: Not that I would WANT to be there anyway!
en: Not that I would WANT to be there anyway!
ja: べつに　行きたいわけでも　ないけどね!

key: The circus is SMELLY!
en: The circus is SMELLY!
ja: サーカスは　くさいんだ!

key: Have you seen the Donphan droppings???
en: Have you seen the Donphan droppings???
ja: ドンファンの　ふんを　見たことが　あるかい???

key: Also they have a restraining order against me.
en: Also they have a restraining order against me.
ja: それに　接近禁止命令まで　出されている

key: But it's mostly about the Donphan!!!!
en: But it's mostly about the Donphan!!!!
ja: でも　だいたいは　ドンファンのせいだ!!!!

key: Look bud, I'll tell you what.
en: Look bud, I'll tell you what.
ja: なあ　相棒　こうしよう

key: I genuinely don't have a Mega Stone for you, but I'll give you this TM and you can let me off the hook, okay?
en: I genuinely don't have a Mega Stone for you, but I'll give you this TM and you can let me off the hook, okay?
ja: メガストーンは　本当に　持っていない。だが　この　わざマシンを　やるから　もう　勘弁してくれ　いいね?

key: Great, everybody go home.
en: Great, everybody go home.
ja: よし　みんな　解散だ

key: Buddy, I really don't got anything else for you, we're done here.
en: Buddy, I really don't got anything else for you, we're done here.
ja: 相棒　もう　本当に　何も　ないんだ。これで　おしまいだよ

key: Take the famous Rainbow Challenge!
en: Take the famous Rainbow Challenge!
ja: 名高い　レインボーチャレンジに　挑戦だ!

key: Now better and realer than ever before and anywhere else!
en: Now better and realer than ever before and anywhere else!
ja: 今なら　かつてなく　どこよりも　上等で　本物だよ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
